identity.patternName: Expectation Projection — Autonomy enablement and team ownership

sourceMaterial.sourceEvidence: Leader Ownership: Enabling Team Autonomy. Squad Ownership: Individual Task Ownership.
sourceMaterial.relationshipLogic: Leader behaviours may imply an expectation that the Squad will operate autonomously, while Squad behaviours may indicate that ownership is still expressed at an individual task level. This may create a difference between the autonomy leadership believes is available and how the Squad currently organises work.

sourceEvaluation.notes: Candidate evidence is not yet an executable trigger. Confirm required, alternative, supporting, and contradictory behaviour combinations before defining conditions.
